name: Base64 Encoder/Decoder
description: Encode and decode Base64 strings instantly using IETF RFC 4648 for U.S. developers — handle text, files, and images with UTF-8 support, all locally in your browser.
longDescription: Base64 Encoder/Decoder provides instant encoding and decoding of Base64 data. All operations follow IETF RFC 4648 (https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc4648) for standard-compliant output. Paste text or upload files to encode. Decode Base64 strings back to text or download as files. Supports UTF-8 for international characters. Handles images, documents, and binary data. All processing happens locally in your browser — no upload to any server, ensuring full privacy for U.S. users and enterprise workflows.
pricingDetails: Completely free — $0 cost versus $12–$29/month encoding tool subscriptions. No file size limits. No uploads to any server.
features: Text encode/decode following IETF RFC 4648 specifications
File upload support with local-only processing for privacy
UTF-8 support for international and U.S. English text
Image to Base64 and Base64 to file download
Zero server uploads — all encoding runs in your browser
Instant results on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS
useCases: U.S. developer embedding images in CSS/HTML using standard Base64
API token encoding and email attachment encoding with RFC 4648 compliance
Data URI generation for web applications
Binary data transport without leaving your device
